records.name: declared_input_evidence_scope
records.detail: Legacy source_only means only the declared assigned evidence was used, including the explicitly supplied CHNS development reference. It does not mean independent target validation. fit_report.json names the source and reports zero retrieval.

records.name: static_program_contract
records.detail: Parsed generator AST without import/execution; verified one synchronous three-argument generate, numpy/pandas imports, and task row/support parameter declarations. Bound static report. Output validity remains unexecuted.

records.name: deterministic_distribution_algebra
records.detail: Analytic moments/CDFs and OLS covariance projections computed; all four component correlations are positive definite with verified Cholesky reconstruction. Rank integral checked at 64x64 versus 96x96 quadrature. Results are fitted development constraints, not independent evidence validation.

records.name: earlier_common_rho_model_diagnostic
records.detail: A pre-trial analytic common-rho model could not jointly reproduce the two supplied glycemic correlations. Its script/report are retained. The submitted generator uses component-specific rho; no synthetic rows were involved in either calculation.

records.name: source_context_replay
records.detail: No source-population simulator/execution adapter is supplied for this task. Target generation is not a replay of differently selected external studies.

records.name: generated_table_validity_and_diagnostics
records.detail: Coordinator isolated trial4201 succeeded, output linkage verified, 3000 rows, all 30 diagnostics computed with matched declared semantics, zero nonpositive glycemia and zero duplicate measurement rows. The candidate generator/spec/evidence are byte-identical to that trial. This does not validate scientific truth or guarantee future draws.

records.name: trial_feedback_review_and_scientific_noop
records.detail: Read and bound complete actual trial4201 feedback; crosschecked all 30 analysis values against semantic calculations. Retain generator/spec/evidence byte-for-byte; distinguish known analytic BMI quantile approximation from single-draw variation in trial_review.json. No new cohort or retrieval.

records.name: initial_delivery_feedback_review
records.detail: Complete actual initial aggregate feedback bound; all 30 statistics for each of the three fixed seeds verified against semantic calculations. Retain scientific files byte-for-byte; review differentiates analytic BMI approximation and finite-draw effects. No scientific validation is claimed.

records.name: analytic_tail_sampling_scale
records.detail: Computed closed-form fourth moments, delta-method SD scales and Pearson influence-function scale from the fitted model. This is deterministic conditional-model mathematics, not extra rows, a formal finite-sample bound, or population validation. Full formulas are retained in prepare_final.py.
